# Synthetic local baseline v2

Generated by the real Windows `HistoricalCloudExporter.ExportBaselineAsync`
from a verified backup of a fresh synthetic ledger. No merchant or customer data.
The nine `HistoricalCloudExportTests` in Win7POS produced this archive using
`WIN7POS_QA_BASELINE_EXPORT_CORPUS` and the two synthetic Getnet input files.

`provenance.json` binds the archive, raw manifest, backup digest, dataset and
existing restore lineage. The Node reader reconciles all seven original tables,
the original Apply receipt and exact CLP totals. This corpus verifies the file
contract; it does not attest baseline admission, authorization or delivery.
Frozen v1 migration rejects this archive unless a future completed admission
explicitly selects the separate v2 contract.
